title: Home health and personal care aides
Licensed practical and licensed vocational nurses
Nurse practitioners
bls_factor_note: Occupational substitution, demand change - share increases as nurse practitioners are increasingly employed in team-based models of care, taking on tasks previously performed by physicians. Expanding practice authority is expected to support employment demand further.

title: Physical therapist aides
bls_factor_note: Demand change - share decreases as payer restrictions in the reimbursement of services provided by physical therapist aides dampens demand for the occupation.

title: Customer service representatives
bls_factor_note: Capital/labor substitution - share decreases as advances in speech and language processing and in artificial intelligence (AI) allow computers to handle customer service interactions with greater frequency.

title: Bookkeeping, accounting, and auditing clerks
bls_factor_note: Productivity change - share decreases as automated bookkeeping software will allow more bookkeeping work to be done by fewer employees.
